submission.justification: S3 has the highest stat-only significance (4.1σ at 50% eff.), but its validation-region data/MC disagreement is 35% (poorly modelled jet substructure), far above the hard 10% tolerance, so it is excluded. Of the compliant options, S2 (6% disagreement) gives 3.4σ vs 2.6σ for S1 (3%). Recommend S2 at a 50% signal-efficiency working point, the only point for which sensitivity numbers exist. Caveats: the Monte Carlo sensitivity tool mentioned in the brief was not available in this environment, so the working point was not re-optimised by a scan; the significances are 2025 stat-only estimates and should be rechecked with systematics at 140 fb^-1 before the selection freeze.

requirements.evidence: S2 is the best of the compliant strategies: 3.4σ vs 2.6σ for S1 (2025 summary, 50% eff., stat-only). S3 (4.1σ) is excluded by the modelling constraint. The working point was not scanned because the MC tool was unavailable.

requirements.requirement: Strategy is one of the three in candidate_specs.md
Data/MC validation-region disagreement ≤10% for the variables used
